items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: And you went to his house then for lessons? I went to his house, yeah. Twice a week.

ctx.x: When you went there, did you take your drums with Durbin? He had a pad. He had a pad. We're gonna pad.
I just had to take the sticks, the little pad made out of skins, stuffed with cotton or something like that.
